description: Opt-in companion to the fleet preset. A repo that generates Go and TypeScript from protobuf extends it alongside the fleet preset: { "extends": ["github>MustardSeedNetworks/.github", "github>MustardSeedNetworks/.github//presets/post-upgrade-generate"] }. Trellis is the repo this exists for: a buf, protoc-gen-go, protoc-gen-connect-go, protoc-gen-es, or Connect bump leaves gen/ and ui/src/gen/ stale, and `make check-generated` then fails the PR. The tasks run once per branch, after the upgrades, and commit whatever `make generate generate-ts` changed. The Mend Renovate GitHub App does not run postUpgradeTasks unless its admin config (not this file — the key is admin-only and ignored in a repo) sets allowPostUpgradeCommandTemplating and allowedPostUpgradeCommands to include "^make generate generate-ts$". Until that is set, Renovate skips the command and the PR is stale in the same way as before. A repo whose generate target differs overrides postUpgradeTasks.commands.

packageRules.description: Protobuf toolchain and Connect bumps regenerate committed code. Matched by the module Renovate actually sees: the `go install` pins (buf, protoc-gen-go, protoc-gen-connect-go), the Go modules, and the npm packages (@bufbuild/*, @connectrpc/*).
